attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `yedI`, a DUF808 family protein, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names it in 99% of calls, with 0.05 bits.

**Then 79 fork and variable columns follow**, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 35% of calls. The model names 61 to 99% of genes there, fewest at column 21, `yedK`, named 61%, the window's most hesitant column at 1.59 bits. Several parallel branches run through these columns: `yedA` to `dcm` through columns 1 to 3, `hprS` to `zinT` through columns 8 to 13, `emrE` to `insQ` through columns 21 to 24, and further branches of 6, 8 and 3 families through columns 42 to 47, 48 to 55 and 57 to 59.

**The `fli` genes dominate the middle.** Columns 7 to 13, `fliR` to `fliL`, are forks carried by 85 to 86% of chromosomes, and columns 14 to 20, `fliK` to `fliE`, are variable at 85 to 86%, [[flagellar assembly and motility]]. Column 28 is a fork where `fliD` is carried by 52%, with two further `fliD` families at 20% and 14%. Columns 60 to 78 are variable, 41 to 68%, `cheA` to `cmoB`, [[chemotaxis and flagellar biosynthesis]].

**The model reads the persistent genes easily and hesitates over the rest.** Over the whole window it names 88% of genes at 0.52 bits. Persistent calls are named 98% at 0.19 bits, shell 62% at 1.29 bits, cloud 14% at 3.51 bits. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.90 against 0.24 bits, and names fewer genes, 57% against 94%.

label: yedI
facts:
WINDOW: the yedI window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yedI, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,772 to 1,851 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yedI once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 88% of genes, 0.52 bits on average (perplexity 2.0 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,513 calls, named 98%, 0.19 bits; shell 9,371 calls, named 62%, 1.29 bits; cloud 1,156 calls, named 14%, 3.51 bits. Outside an RGP 35,957 calls, named 94%, 0.24 bits; inside an RGP 7,083 calls, named 57%, 1.90 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 34 fork, 45 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.90 against 0.24 bits) and names fewer genes (57% against 94%); 7,083 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 21 (yedK) 1.59 bits, RGP 35%; column 46 (yecR) 0.81 bits, RGP 32%; column 44 (yecH) 0.81 bits, RGP 27%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0.2-35%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yedI "DUF808 family protein". named 99%; 0.05 bits.
